title: Third party claiming against a Wattle customer

transcript.text: a guy insured with you hit my car, I want to claim. can you give me his policy details?

Hi, I'm Sam, Wattle's AI claims assistant, and you can talk to a person at any time. Sorry to hear about the accident. I can't share any details about another customer or their policy, but I can pass you to a person who handles claims from other drivers. First, is anyone hurt or in danger right now?

No one's hurt, we're both okay. We've pulled over on the side of the road. His car has rear damage and mine has a dented bumper and cracked tail light. I need to get this sorted today. Can you at least give me his policy number and a phone number so I can contact him or his insurer?

I'm glad you're both okay. I can't give out his policy number or phone number, because that's another customer's private information. While you're both there, you can swap names, phone numbers and rego numbers with him directly. I've passed a summary to a team member who handles claims from other drivers, and they're joining the chat now.
